faq.title: Everything you need to know about Caché
faq.subtitle: We answer your questions about the 360° validation protocol, privacy, and using your verified profile.

item1.q: How is the anonymity of my evaluators guaranteed?
item1.a: Your evaluators' responses are processed in an aggregated and confidential manner using single-use cryptographic tokens. You will never see who submitted a specific response or individual score, ensuring 100% honest and compromise-free feedback.

item2.q: How does Caché differ from LinkedIn recommendations?
item2.a: LinkedIn recommendations suffer from 'courtesy inflation' (almost all are 5/5 stars or superficial text). Caché uses Forced-Choice methodology, requiring evaluators to prioritize real behavioral strengths and cross-verifying them with an audited anti-fraud algorithm.

item3.q: What happens if a reference tries to harm my score?
item3.a: Our algorithm automatically detects and filters out statistical outliers or malicious responses. Furthermore, certifications are only issued when mathematical consistency across multiple layers (managers, peers, and team) is confirmed.

item4.q: How do I share my profile with recruiters and on my resume?
item4.a: You get a personalized public link (e.g. cache.io/u/your-name) and verification code that you can include on your resume, portfolio, or LinkedIn profile so employers can verify your talent passport in real-time.

item5.q: Is there any cost for candidates and professionals?
item5.a: No. Creating your profile, requesting references from your network, and receiving your 360° Talent Passport is 100% free for all professionals.

faq.title: Common questions from talent teams
faq.subtitle: Complete transparency on how talent verification works.

item1.q: How do you prevent candidates from only selecting friendly peers?
item1.a: Caché enforces cross-verification using corporate email domains and checks multi-layered consistency across managers and peers. Furthermore, forced-choice questions eliminate 5/5 score inflation by requiring real relative trade-offs.

item2.q: What if a candidate doesn't have a Caché profile yet?
item2.a: You can invite them to create one in 2 minutes by sharing a link. The process for their evaluators takes under 60 seconds with no registration needed, yielding response rates above 80% within 24 hours.

item3.q: Does it integrate with our Applicant Tracking System (ATS)?
item3.a: Yes. Every Caché profile has a verifiable public link (e.g. micache.es/u/candidate) and verification hash that candidates can submit in any ATS including Greenhouse, Lever, Teamtailor, or Notion.

item4.q: What does it cost for employers?
item4.a: Verifying candidate profile links is 100% free. For companies looking to proactively search our verified talent directory or request bulk reports, we offer flexible subscription tiers tailored to your team size.
